item.title: Eastern DR Congo: the situation
item.description:
M23 rebels have shifted from Bunia to open a new front near the Uganda border, advancing toward Uvira city, while Ugandan forces are pulling out of a Congolese town after a diplomatic dispute involving Muhoozi Kainerugaba's social media posts. In Ituri, fighting forced WHO to evacuate its Ebola response team from a hospital as the outbreak surpassed 12,000 cases. A South African mercenary pilot was captured, raising concerns about foreign fighters. The conflict caused 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
